newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed in late short covering surge.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed in late short covering surge.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures settled mixed after a volatile close that saw front-month March gain on continued short covering and spreading, traders said.
"This was end-of-week and end-of-month short covering," a trader said. "The further strength in KC March came as people had to pay up to get coverage."

March gained in early price action on bull-spreading tied to the delivery of 150,000 bushels of wheat, which was at the low end of expectations. The bull-spreading in March weighed on the May contract throughout the session, traders said.
July wheat weakened early on increased chances for moisture next week in HRW wheat areas, but July firmed late as commission house Wolcott Lincoln bought 3.5 million bushels.
KCBT wheat settled 1-1/4 cents per bushel lower to 4-1/4 cents higher, with March up 4-1/4 cents at $4.23. May lost 1-1/4 cents to close at 4.00.
The March/May spread traded late at 21-1/2 cents, after having opened at 18-1/2 cents.
E D & F Man International bull-spread 900,000 March/May at 20-1/2 to 21-1/2 cents. Wolcott also bought 1.5 million March and bull-spread one million May/July at 26-1/2 to 27 cents.
